marketing_description: DeWALT® DCN930P1 framing nailer in the MAX XR® Series delivers a 2 to 3-1/2 in nail length with a 7/62 to 0.131 in diameter, housed in a black/yellow chassis and powered by a 20 V MAX XR® Lithium‑Ion 5 Ah battery. The strip magazine with a 30‑degree angle loads from the rear and the brushless motor provides fast performance and maximum runtime, while the tool‑free depth adjustment and selectable bump or sequential trigger allow precise nail setting. A stall‑release lever quickly resets the driver blade if a stall occurs.
